reeval.extended_record: The patient has never received biologic therapy (omalizumab, mepolizumab, benralizumab) or systemic immunosuppressants; she is biologic-naive. She is not pregnant or breastfeeding, uses a copper IUD for contraception, and reports a known drug allergy to penicillin (rash). Spirometry performed two weeks ago showed FEV1 62% predicted with post-bronchodilator improvement of 15% and 240 mL, consistent with reversible airflow obstruction. Her ACQ-7 score was 3.1, indicating poorly controlled asthma. Inhaler adherence was assessed via pharmacy refill data and patient diary, showing approximately 80% adherence to her ICS-LABA regimen over the past three months. Her most recent exacerbation requiring an emergency department visit occurred five weeks ago, treated with a burst of oral prednisone 40 mg daily for five days.
